lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: You know what they charge for a burger on Europa Station?

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Enough to make the cow request hazard pay?

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Fourteen credits. Doesn't even come with chips.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: A little card saying the lettuce was grown locally.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Locally where? Europa has ice and disappointment.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Hydroponics deck. They call it sustainable.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: What do they call the big burger?

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Because after eating one you need heat shielding.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Three choices. Red, yellow, and legally distinct beige.
